policy.purpose: Dedicated M1 syntactic-inversion acceptance. Tests semantic-role invariance under Russian constituent scrambling without relying on canonical SVO order.
policy.rule: Oracle fixes intended predicate/role semantics. Punctuation is kept grammatical in this suite so failures isolate inversion rather than punctuation noise. Equivalent surface permutations share equivalence_group where useful.
